notes.title: Update ver.3.3.3
notes.content:
Online cross-matching is now supported.
Different platforms can play together online.

tags.feature: Different platforms can play together online.

notes.title: Update ver.2.2.2
notes.content:
１．Private tournaments are now available.
２．Viewer waiting rooms (for Live Streamer) have been implemented.
３．The region of the online connection can now be selected.

tags.feature: ２．Viewer waiting rooms (for Live Streamer) have been implemented.
３．The region of the online connection can now be selected.

notes.title: Update ver.2.1.1
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused accessories to be distorted when attached to "chest, shoulders, hands".

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that caused accessories to be distorted when attached to "chest, shoulders, hands".

notes.title: Update ver.2.0.1
notes.content:
1. 179 types of accessories have been added.
2. Accessories can now be attached to the chest, shoulders, and hands.
3. Implemented "Character Directory". You can browse the characters you have played online in the past.
4. Implemented online tournament function.

tags.feature: 179 types of accessories have been added.
Accessories can now be attached to the chest, shoulders, and hands.
Implemented "Character Directory". You can browse the characters you have played online in the past.

notes.title: Update ver.1.3.0
notes.content:
1. Added an interrupt save function in single mode (you can select it from the system menu during single mode play)
2. Fixed a bug that caused the game to stop progressing when both players requested a rematch at the same time in an online battle.

tags.feature: 1. Added an interrupt save function in single mode (you can select it from the system menu during single mode play)

tags.bug: 2. Fixed a bug that caused the game to stop progressing when both players requested a rematch at the same time in an online battle.

notes.title: Update ver.1.2.0
notes.content:
1. Added "End Game" button to system menu.
2. Reduced the load on the Japanese dance scene.
3. Added matching server name display while staying in the online lobby.
4. Fixed a bug that the best score in challenge mode was not recorded properly.
